naive_reporting_criterion.description: The naive estimate 'asserts a direction' when its two-sided 95% t-interval over the 5 replicate naive paired means excludes zero.

analysis.reduction_order: left-to-right float addition in ascending evaluation_seed then ascending replicate_index; cell means rounded to 6 decimals before differencing; identical to SEEDVAR-V7-TRAINING-REPLICATE-DEV-V1

arms.description: Policy action clipped to [-1, 1] and applied directly; alpha = 1.0 makes the shared wrapper an identity filter so both arms run identical code paths.
Applied action = alpha * clipped policy action + (1 - alpha) * previous applied action, alpha = 0.25, the same operator and constant as the v7 V7C_FILTERED_ACTION arm.

claim_boundary: Supports only: whether the naive per-step saturation estimator and the assumption-free bound disagree on a public benchmark under early termination.
Does not support: any statement about Walker2d locomotion quality, about low-pass action filtering as a design choice, about the v7 humanoid, or about physical actuators.
Development evidence; not preregistered; no candidate is selected; no threshold is tuned after seeing results.

evaluation.exposure_rule: realized_steps == horizon_control_steps -> FULL_EXPOSURE else EARLY_TERMINATED; derived from trace length only, never from the terminated flag alone
evaluation.outcome_state_rule: OBSERVED when every recorded numeric is finite, NONFINITE otherwise; OBSERVED never implies FULL_EXPOSURE

P1_censoring_present.if_false: SECOND_CASE_UNINFORMATIVE_NO_CENSORING: with full exposure everywhere the bound equals the naive value and nothing can disagree; the case says nothing about the artifact and is reported as such.
P1_censoring_present.statement: At the frozen budget, in at least 3 of 5 replicates at least one arm has fewer than 30 FULL_EXPOSURE episodes.

P2_naive_bound_disagreement.if_blocked_by_method_failure: SECOND_CASE_BLOCKED_METHOD_FAILURE: a training or evaluation method failure (FAILED cell or NONFINITE episode) makes that replicate's paired difference NULL; the replicate is retained, the denominator stays 5, and no method-level decision is issued.
P2_naive_bound_disagreement.if_false_both_agree: SECOND_CASE_NAIVE_AND_BOUND_AGREE: the artifact did not bite at this budget; reported as a negative result for the generalizability claim.
P2_naive_bound_disagreement.if_false_bound_identified_naive_uncertai: SECOND_CASE_BOUND_IDENTIFIED_NAIVE_UNCERTAIN: the bound excludes zero while the naive t-interval does not; censoring did not manufacture a direction here.
P2_naive_bound_disagreement.statement: Given P1, at the method level the naive 95% t-interval excludes zero while the identification bound theta contains zero.

P3_observed_not_full_exposure.role: descriptive support for claim A-C2; not a pass/fail gate
P3_observed_not_full_exposure.statement: Every EARLY_TERMINATED episode carries outcome_state OBSERVED (all numerics finite).

predictions.no_direction_prediction: No prediction is made about the sign of W2D_C_FILTERED minus W2D_A_DIRECT. Both signs are consistent with the hypothesis under test; the hypothesis concerns the naive estimator, not the arms.

preregistration.disclosure: This protocol was authored after the v7 exposure-censoring audit and seed-variance results were known. It is an internal hash freeze, not an external (OSF) preregistration. Predictions P1 and P2 and every threshold below were fixed before any Walker2d training or evaluation run under this protocol.

primary_measurement.definition: 100 * saturated (control step, joint) pairs / (control steps * joints). Naive form divides by realized steps; identified form divides by the full horizon and reports the assumption-free bound [100*s/(H*J), 100*(s + (H - n)*J)/(H*J)].
primary_measurement.units_note: H = 1000 control steps x J = 6 joints

purpose: Test whether the exposure-censoring artifact measured on the v7 humanoid line reproduces on a public benchmark with a different plant, a from-scratch policy and no project-specific control code: an early-terminating arm's naive per-step rate metric can assert a direction that the assumption-free full-horizon identification bound does not support.

shared_action_interface.note: Both arms append the 6-D previous applied action to the observation so observation dimension, network shape and code path are identical; the only difference between arms is alpha.

training.realized_timesteps_note: 147 rollouts x 2048 steps; requested equals realized so the contract can require exact equality.
